title: Polyglots or Multitudes? Multilingual LLM Answers to Value-laden Multiple-Choice Questions
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating LLMs using the Multilingual European Value Survey (MEVS), which probes moral, ethical, and societal values. It explicitly tests model alignment and consistency on topics such as work ethics, family obligations, gender equality, and attitudes toward homosexuality, all of which fall under the study of morals and ethics.
